scope: Proposition 4.9 of the manuscript “Bloch’s conjecture for surfaces with p_g=0” (preprints/Blochs-Conjecture-for-Surfaces-with-pg-equals-q-equals-0-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 040 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 afb7bf56f8d97111), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume pg = q = 1, K ample, and D = 3K. Every fixed contribution vanishes except those obtained from a low divisor equal to the empty divisor or to the canonical divisor. In either surviving case the contribution is computed on the actual fiber |Da| × X[na] × X[nb] , with the factors e(Fa) e(Fb). The low hyperplane is xb = 0 and mDb = 0; pushforward over |Da| is extraction at x mDa a . The overall multiplier is 1 for the empty divisor and −s, with the same s > 0 as in (4.16), for the canonical divisor. The statement applies to operational insertions in universal perfect complexes, also after adjoining marked surface factors.
